records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue from software and related services was approximately 19% of our total revenue during the first three quarters of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our backlog was approximately $239 million and $154 million at September 30, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively, primarily driven by strong order growth during the year and longer lead times for certain components.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: ◦The aggregate of changes in prepaid assets, deferred revenue and other assets and liabilities used cash of $37 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2022 compared to $52 million in the comparable period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of September 30, 2022, we estimate our distributors were carrying less than $15 million of our products in inventory in total, and the majority of these distributors are not eligible for significant price adjustments related to their previous purchases.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2022 and 2021, operating income was $80 million and $34 million, respectively.
